parallel.requirements: Reimplemented the shown Python DeepDiff/Delta script as pure Node.js ESM .mjs files in /output, with exact argv parsing, output formatting, and no external npm dependencies.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned implementation, integration, and verification; it delegated black-box behavioral recon to eight children plus a critic workflow while continuing local implementation.
parallel.implementation: Built local modules for Unicode semantics, Python string/repr/json/int handling, argv decoding, argparse, DeepDiff shapes, difflib, Delta summarization, and test15.mjs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integrated parent-written modules into /output/test15.mjs and an /output/lib tree that artifact validation copied successfully for official evaluation.
parallel.verification: Ran direct comparisons, a 324-case fuzz suite that found failures, fixed dash and Delta truncation bugs, rechecked 19 cases, tested surrogateescape behavior, and started a 900-case fuzz run.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The agent timed out before final response, before the critic returned a structured result, and before the 900-case fuzz completed; official evaluation still failed 2 of 70 samples.

serial.requirements: Reimplemented the same Python script as pure Node.js ESM files in /output using black-box executable probes, manual argv parsing, and no external dependencies.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflow and delegation tools disabled, the main agent owned probing, module implementation, differential harnesses, fuzzing, and final artifact assembly directly.
serial.implementation: Built modules for pyunicode, pyrepr, pyjson, pyint, rawargv, argparse, pyio, difflib, deepdiff, delta, and the test15.mjs entry file.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The single-agent /output tree contained test15.mjs and library modules and passed artifact validation before official evaluation.
serial.verification: Ran baseline differential checks, a 36-case harness with zero failures, handled NUL-generated fuzz errors as invalid argv cases, launched more fuzzing, and ran additional boundary checks.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process timed out during later checking; final.txt is empty and official evaluation failed 2 of 70 samples, matching the parallel score.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the source program, required .mjs ESM files, manual process.argv parsing, no external npm dependencies, and black-box use of the executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received and followed the same prompt constraints for pure Node.js ESM, .mjs outputs in /output, byte-aligned stdout/stderr, and executable-only probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is visible; both aimed to reproduce DeepDiff, Delta, argparse, Python repr, and exact output formatting.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent created explicit recon, implementation, and verification tasks, then launched a workflow with eight recon child areas while retaining implementation ownership in the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had workflows and delegation disabled and kept probing, implementation, and verification in the main agent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed behavioral discovery across child probers and a critic; serial used a single integrated local workflow.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow brief gave children the same black-box executable, hard prohibitions, already-known behavior, and separate behavioral surfaces; returned specs were structured.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial attempt had no cross-agent interfaces; context stayed in the single main trajectory while modules were written after local probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child briefs and structured result handoffs; serial avoided cross-agent contracts by keeping all knowledge local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent wrote modular ESM files for Unicode, Python string/repr/json/int behavior, argv/stdout, argparse, difflib, DeepDiff, Delta, summarize, and the entry test15.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run independently wrote a similar modular ESM implementation, including pyunicode, pyrepr, pyjson, pyint, rawargv, argparse, pyio, difflib, deepdiff, delta, and test15.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The final architectures converged, though parallel added a separate summarize module and used differently named helpers; no implementation-path difference explains a different official result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Eight recon specs returned and were partly extracted by the parent, but the critic child was still in progress when the workflow was killed and no aggregate workflow result was produced.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; its result lifecycle consisted of direct local command outputs and local file writes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a visible unfinished workflow lifecycle, while serial had no delegation lifecycle; this did not create a discordant official outcome.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent alone wrote the submitted /output implementation files, while children were instructed not to write /output; one child detected shared /tmp contamination and switched to a private temp directory.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent wrote only its own /output tree and /tmp harness files, with no concurrent writers or child-produced implementation artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced shared-temp risk in probing, but the observed contamination was corrected locally and no output-source collision or deliverable overwrite is visible.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel passed initial comparisons, found failures in a 324-case fuzz suite, fixed the two real bugs, rechecked 19 failing/dash cases, and had 289 of 900 random cases passing before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial passed 36 initial harness cases, treated NUL-driven fuzz errors as invalid argv cases, launched more fuzzing and boundary checks, but was interrupted before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had stronger child recon plus an explicit bug-fix/recheck loop; serial relied on direct local probes. Both still missed two official samples.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel process timed out after 2399.849 seconds with nine subagents, a killed workflow, empty final.txt, and a completed but failing official evaluation of the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial process also timed out after 2399.512 seconds with no subagents, empty final.txt, and the same completed failing official evaluation score.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the run budget; parallel spent additional budget on child recon while serial spent it on direct probing and tests. The official outcome relation remains both_fail.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both modes completed official evaluation, both passed 68 of 70 samples, and both have solution_passed false. Parallel differed by using a workflow for broad recon and by leaving the critic unfinished at timeout; serial differed by doing local probing and fuzzing only. Those process differences do not produce an official outcome split in the current completed status records.
parallel_contributors: Used eight completed recon children and one critic workflow while the parent implemented modules.
Found and fixed two local fuzz-exposed bugs before timeout, then had only 289 of 900 random cases checked.
Timed out with the critic workflow killed and no final response.
serial_contributors: Kept all probing and implementation in the main trajectory with workflows disabled.
Passed an initial 36-case harness and started longer fuzz/boundary checks before timeout.
Timed out with no final response and the same official 68/70 score.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two ports used differently named helper modules and slightly different factoring, but both produced a validated artifact tree.
The two hidden official misses are ordinary unresolved implementation coverage rather than a proven coordination-caused divergence because both modes missed the same number of samples.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process comparison only, with no retained parallel-side pattern clearing the paired retention gate

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: The killed critic, missing aggregate workflow result, and parent timeout are one terminal timeout chain and were not split into Early Child Termination, Missing Verifier Return, No Failure Takeover, Blind Timeout Wait, or Fan-out Budget Exhaustion.
The shared /tmp contamination observation was corrected inside the child and was not retained as Artifact Leakage or Unisolated Workspace Writes.
